title: Verification certificate
description: The re-checkable certificate emitted by pi-xorq-check for an ADR-0001 verification. Produced verbatim by the deterministic checker; the verifier returns it unchanged.

verdict.description: Turn-level verdict, a monotone fold over obligation statuses.

status.description: Per-obligation status on DISCHARGED ⊑ COULD-NOT-DISCHARGE ⊑ REFUTED.

checks.description: Named boolean checks recorded during discharge (well-formedness, predicate, faithfulness, provenance).

surface.description: The claimed value verbatim — the left-hand side of the typed equality the discharge tested. Disclosed so the certificate records what was checked, not just the outcome.

selected_cell.description: The cell the witness selected, as text; null when nothing was selected — including every `table` obligation, whose content is the `grid` (a table has no single cell).

grid.description: Present only for a `table` obligation: the verified grid (what was confirmed), replacing selected_cell. `rows` are the claimed rows that matched the witness result under typed equality.

value_type.description: The declared typing under which surface and selected_cell were compared. The tolerance is a producer-declared knob that widens acceptance, so it is disclosed here to be re-checkable.

witness_alias.description: The declared alias the witness was composed ON — its input/base, NOT the persisted witness. null when the witness did not run. (The persisted witness's own name, when cataloged, is witness_ref.)

witness_code.description: The compose code that discharges this obligation, so the certificate is re-runnable (`xorq catalog run <witness_alias> -c <witness_code>`). Empty when the witness did not run.

witness_hash.description: A short content handle (sha256:<16 hex>) for witness_code — an integrity/dedup reference to the exact expression that was checked; empty when there was no witness.

witness_ref.description: The cataloged alias of the PERSISTED witness — a composed `verify-<id>` entry (id = the obligation id) that was re-run and confirmed to reproduce this result — when catalog_witnesses is on; empty otherwise. This is the re-runnable expression's name, distinct from witness_alias (the base it composed on). Empty guarantees no such alias was left in the catalog (a failed round-trip is cleaned up, never orphaned).

sources.description: The witness alias's ACTUAL lineage — one entry per op-tree leaf, recovered from the catalog (not producer-declared): the URL/path for a Read, or a `<in-memory>` / `<Type:name>` marker for a leaf with no source (a hand-built table). This is what the `no_local_sources` policy judges (`remote_sources` check). A local path or a `<in-memory>` marker here on a claimed-verified answer is the tell of data added straight to the catalog.

catalog_state.description: A short content handle (sha256:<16 hex>) for the catalog.yaml manifest the obligations were discharged against — pins which catalog state produced this verdict. Empty when the manifest could not be read.

uncovered.description: Surface values from reply_values not covered by any obligation; a non-empty list downgrades VERIFIED to COULD-NOT-VERIFY.

soundness.description: The soundness boundary of the verdict.
